nodes.line: You right there? I am mid-something but go on.

Right. Since you asked. The number three green at Wynyard has had a bald patch the shape of Tasmania since the long weekend, and the committee thinks I am inventing it. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Just do not come back empty-handed.

My knees are gone, so. They have seen the photograph and now they want it re-laid by the long weekend, which means finding $35 that the Wynyard club does not have. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. I will know if you skipped a bit.
Sit. Talk. Then I will decide how I feel.

choices.text: The Dead Patch at Wynyard — that's done.

npcs.name: Tia, night console operator at Epping

nodes.line: Long day. Say what you came to say.

npcs.name: Paz, the one who does the bins at Loftus

nodes.line: Whatever it is, I have had worse this week.

Do not laugh. Three units at Loftus have put their bins out on the wrong night since the first of the month and I have taken it personally, which I accept is a choice I made. I have rung the number on the letter four times. Ask for me by name at the counter.

It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. There is a block at Sutherland with the same builder and the same cracks, and their manager has already been through what Loftus is starting. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Come back and tell me straight.
You came back. That already puts you ahead.

The Other Block, Loftus — that's done.
